_about: T-059 M2 exit: the PLAN.md §1 M2 exit scenarios and the Done-when CLIN ids mapped to the exact test cases that prove each (JUnit classname = file, name = 'describe > test'). Checked by check-scenarios.py against a JUnit report of `pnpm test -- m2`: the required scenario titles and CLIN ids present; every title a PRD §8 scenario and every CLIN id a PRD CLIN row; every mapped name in its file; every mapped case present once and passed; no failure anywhere. 'proves' states what the cases assert; 'open' what is not proven in M2 and the task that completes it.
